## WF-02 SAM.gov Get Opportunities Public API
GET https://api.sam.gov/opportunities/v2/search (postedFrom/postedTo MM/dd/yyyy, limit<=1000, offset). Filters: state=TX (all of Texas), property-service NAICS. Private leads remain a DFW pilot; public bids are statewide.
Stores permitted metadata only + sha256 hash; unique (source_id, source_record_id[, hash]) prevents duplicates. Public bids are labeled non-exclusive and link to the original notice.
Set env SAM_GOV_API_KEY, SAM_SOURCE_ID (row in sources). Daily request quota depends on SAM.gov account role.
Add Texas SmartBuy / city portals as separate branches only after terms review.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ source_id: $env.SAM_SOURCE_ID, source_record_id: $json.source_record_id, source_url: $json.source_url, payload_hash: $json.payload_hash, permitted_payload: $json.permitted_payload }) }}

const now=Date.now();
return $input.all().filter(i=>{const p=i.json.permitted_payload||{}; const d=p.responseDeadLine?Date.parse(p.responseDeadLine):null; return p.active!=='No' && (!d || d>now);});
